# 3+1D complex-fermion exchange terms

**Phase convention:** physical, as fixed in the [formula guide](../FORMULA_GUIDE.md#phase-convention): the forward F move carries $`\nu`$, the consistency loop runs forward along $`D`$ and back along $`N`$, the insertions are $`X=P\Gamma`$ and $`\bar X=\bar P\Gamma^\dagger`$, and coefficients are signed minimal representatives.

The complete complex-fermion–p+ip stacking contribution on the ordered
four-simplex is

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{ℰ}_4^{c\psi}(01234)
={}&\frac12\Big[
 \mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi[n_1]\cup_3n'_3
 +\Delta\big(n_3\cup_3\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi\big)\\
&\qquad+(n_3+n'_3)\cup_2\Delta B_3+dB_3\cup_3n'_3+n_3\cup_2R'_3+B_3\cup_2n'_3\\
&\qquad+(B_3+R'_3)\cup_2(\mathcal{ℰ}_3+\Delta B_3)+(dn_3+dB_3)\cup_3R'_3\\
&\qquad+\Delta\big(B_3\cup_3(dn_3+dB_3)+n_3\cup_2B_3\big)\\
&\qquad+\omega_2\mathcal B_2+\mathcal B_2^2+d\mathcal B_2\cup_1\mathcal B_2
 +(\mathcal{ℰ}_3+\Delta B_3+d\mathcal B_2)\cup_2d\mathcal B_2\\
&\qquad+d\mathcal B_2\cup_3(dN_3+dB_3[N])\\
&\qquad+(B_3+R'_3)\cup_1\lambda_2^\gamma+\lambda_2^\gamma\cup_1B_3^+
 +(\lambda_2^\gamma)^2+\omega_2\lambda_2^\gamma\\
&\qquad+d_{s_1}\big(\lambda_2^\gamma\cup_1\lambda_2^\gamma+\lambda_2^\gamma\cup_2d\lambda_2^\gamma
 +B_3\cup_3(\mathcal{ℰ}_3+n'_3)+R'_3\cup_3\mathcal{ℰ}_3+B_3[N]\cup_2\lambda_2^\gamma\big)\\
&\qquad+(dn_3+dn'_3+dB_3+dR'_3)\cup_4\big[
 \omega_2\mathcal{ℰ}_2+s_1(B_3[N]+B_3^+)\big]\Big](01234)\\
&+\frac12(dn_3+dB_3)(01234)\Big[
 n'_2(012)(dn_2)(0234)
 +n_2(034)(dn'_2)(0123)\\
&\qquad+n'_2(123)(dn_2)(0134)
 +n_2(014)(dn'_2)(1234)
 +n'_2(234)(dn_2)(0124)\\
&\qquad+s_1(01)\Big\{
 n'_2(124)(dn_2)(1234)
 +[n_2(123)+n'_2(123)](dn'_2)(1234)
 \Big\}\Big]\\
&+\frac12(dn'_3+dR'_3)(01234)\Big[
 n'_2(012)(dn_2)(0234)
 +n_2(034)(dn'_2)(0123)\\
&\qquad+s_1(01)\Big\{
 [n_2(123)+n'_2(124)](dn_2)(1234)
 +n_2(123)(dn'_2)(1234)
 \Big\}\Big].
\end{aligned}
```

The two face brackets contain **13 explicit products** after distributing
the displayed binary parentheses: eight multiply $`dn_3+dB_3`$ and five multiply
$`dn'_3+dR'_3`$, with $`B_3=n_2\cup_1n_2`$. The lower differentials are
$`dn_2=\widetilde{\omega}_2[n_1]_2`$ and $`dn'_2=\widetilde{\omega}_2[n'_1]_2`$.
On identical complete inputs, the terms proportional to $`s_1(01)`$ and
the first two products cancel between the two face brackets. The remaining
expression is exactly

```math
\frac12(dn_3+dB_3)(01234)\Big[
 n_2(123)(dn_2)(0134)
 +n_2(014)(dn_2)(1234)
 +n_2(234)(dn_2)(0124)\Big].
```

These **three face products** appear in the
[self-stacking formula](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_SELF_STACKING.md).

## Exact proof

The [standalone verifier](coefficients/verify_three_dimensional_cf_exchange.py)
compares the 13-product expression with the
[normalized MS-word form](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_PRODUCT_CF_WORDS.md) of the same
exchange. Its inputs are arbitrary degree-two Majorana cochains, arbitrary
degree-three complex-fermion differentials, and a closed sign background;
all 50 independent four-simplex bits are checked at once as exact
coefficient polynomials, and the residual is identically zero.

## The obstruction

The complex-fermion–p+ip obstruction contribution is

```math
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{𝒪}_5^{c\psi}
 =\frac12\Big[&(\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi})\cup_3\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi
  +\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi\cup_3(\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi})
  +\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi\cup_3\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi\\
 &+d(n_2\cup_1n_2)\cup_2(n_2\cup_1n_2)
  +d(n_2\cup_1n_2)\cup_3\big(dn_3+d(n_2\cup_1n_2)\big)\\
 &+\sum_{(v;\mathbf x)\in\mathcal I_5^{c\psi}}
       \mathop{\mathrm{MS}}\nolimits_v(\mathbf x)\Big].
\end{aligned}
```

The sum has **seven MS terms**, given in the
[word table](THREE_DIMENSIONAL_WORD_INDICES.md#complex-fermion-indices); their
first input is the binary cochain $`dn_3+dB_3`$. The three cups in the first
line come from the complete lower equation
$`dn_3=\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\gamma+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^{\gamma\psi}+\mathcal{𝒪}_4^\psi`$;
the two cups with $`B_3`$ come from the pairing reference and vanish for
$`n_1=0`$.

The [standalone verifier](coefficients/verify_three_dimensional_source_cf_exchange.py)
checks the seven-word form against the full word expansion on a five-simplex:
20 free Majorana faces, 15 free complex-fermion faces, ten closed-background
bits, and five closed-sign bits, all **50 independent binary variables** at once.
